akkhāhata：အက္ခာဟတ（တိ） （အက္ခ+အာဟတ）
ဝင်ရိုးကို ခတ်မိသည်။
DOP: 1 akkha m. n. [ S. akṣa 1 ], 1. an axle, an axle-tree ; Abh 375; 893; Vin I 231, 37 (yugena yugaṃ cakkena cakkaṃ ~ena ~aṃ paṭivaṭṭesi) ≠ D II 96, 11 ; S IV 177, 2 (~aṃ abbhañjeyya); Ja I 192, 24 (yugakoṭiṃ ca ~āni pādaṃ ca nissāya); Mil 27, 3 (~o ratho ti na hi bhante ti); — 2. the collar-bone ; — ifc see adh’- ( sv adho ); — °’- aggakīla , m. , a linch-pin ; Abh 374; — °’- āhata , mfn. [akkha + āhata 1 ], fixed on an axle ; M III 173, 26 (cakkaratanaṃ … ~aṃ maññe tiṭṭhati); A I 112, 5 ([cakkaṃ] ~aṃ maññe aṭṭhāsi; Mp II 181, 13 : akkhe pavesetvā ṭhapitaṃ iva); — °- cchinna , mfn. , whose axle is broken ; S I 57, 22* (visamaṃ maggam āruyha ~o va jhāyati) = Mil 66, 30* ; — °- bandhanayotta , n. , an axle-rope ; Ja I 192, 2 ; — °- bhagga , mfn. [akkha + bhagga 1 ], with a broken axle ; Ja V 433, 8 (~aṃ ca yānaṃ); — see also akkhi 2 .
CPD: akkhâhata , mfn. ( i. e. 1 akkha + āhata), firm ( fixed ) upon an axle ( said of a wheel ), AN l 112, 5 (cakkaṃ . . . ~aṃ maññe aṭṭhāsi; Mp: akkhe pa- vesetvā thapitam iva); MN lll 173, 26 (cakka- ratanaṃ) ≠ DN ll 174, 8 ; lll 63, 20 ( cf. Pj l 172, 18 ; 176, 10 ).
NCP: mfn. | akkhaahata fixed on an axle See also: akkha
